name: Pueblo County, CO
findings: Pueblo County has 512 nonprofit organizations. 215 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 174 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Pueblo County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
47% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Few social and fraternal organizations list public events
observations.text: 6 social and fraternal organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 22 would.

confidence.text: Based on 22 organizations here; 57% of all organizations here have no identified type.
